en.name: Tooth Extraction
en.meta_title: Gentle Tooth Extractions: Simple & Surgical Tooth Removal
en.meta_description: We perform gentle tooth extractions with your comfort as our top priority. Learn when an extraction is necessary, from severe decay to impacted wisdom teeth, and about our simple and surgical removal procedures.
en.meta_keywords: tooth extraction, tooth removal, surgical extraction, wisdom tooth removal, dental surgery, oral surgery

what_is.heading: When is a Tooth Extraction Necessary?
paragraphs: While our primary goal is always to save a natural tooth, sometimes a tooth extraction is the necessary course of action to protect your overall oral health. At LUNAI, we perform tooth extractions with the utmost care and gentleness, ensuring your comfort is our top priority.

reasons.heading: Reasons for Extraction
paragraphs: An extraction may be necessary for several reasons: a tooth may be too severely decayed or damaged to be repaired; advanced gum disease may have destroyed the supporting bone; a tooth may be impacted (like many wisdom teeth); or teeth may need to be removed to create space for orthodontic treatment.

procedure.heading: Simple and Surgical Extractions
paragraphs: We offer both simple extractions for visible teeth and surgical extractions for teeth that are broken or impacted. The procedure is performed under local anesthesia to completely numb the area. Our team provides detailed post-operative instructions to ensure a smooth recovery and can discuss excellent tooth replacement options.
